source: Base part masses of the garage part-mass tree (rg/part_mass.h; owner on PR #19, 2026-10-15: each part has its own mass and a parent carries the cumulative mass of its children). Engine and gearbox masses are NOT here: they are the engine catalogue's and the gearbox catalogue's per-part figures (the engine figure is the bare naturally aspirated engine; factory forced induction is its own turbo_system group below it, sized from the turbo configuration). Wheel and tyre masses are NOT here either: each wheel's mass is the vehicle file's own wheel_mass. Everything else a vehicle file names gets the figure below, keyed by component type (and differential kind / electronics kind); the removable interior and panel parts (the catalogue's per-car "interior" map and the garage's Weight reduction part choices) are keyed by their own names. Every figure is an invented [AS] value with its reasoning in its own source; none was checked against a citation. Sized parts add per_capacity_kg x the part's size (fuel tank and N2O bottle: capacity in kg; fuel and n2o: the spawn fill in kg; turbo parts: see each entry). The CONTENTS (fuel, nitrous oxide) are counted at their spawn fill (owner on PR #22, 2026-10-16): a vehicle file with contents_mass.enabled lets physics_sim carry them on the chassis body and lighten it as they are used (physics_sim PR #10), so the tree marks them carried and the drive's chassis leaves them out. physics_carries lists further parts physics_sim simulates as masses of their own; it is empty: wheel_mass is spin inertia only, the drivetrain parts are rotating inertias only, and the body mass is the only translational mass of the car. The per-car body is the catalogue's chassis.body_mass_kg: since PR #22 an independent [AS] figure for the bare shell (owner: interior ripped out, no engine assembly, no drivetrain, no wheels), no longer back-calculated from an old total.

clutch.label: Clutch
clutch.source: [AS] pressure plate, disc and release bearing of a single-plate dry clutch, 7-11 kg for passenger cars (recalled); the flywheel is counted with the engine.

propshaft.label: Propshaft
propshaft.source: [AS] a two-piece steel propshaft with its centre bearing, 10-15 kg for a saloon (recalled); only cars whose driven axle is at the far end from the engine have one.

halfshaft.label: Half shaft
halfshaft.source: [AS] one driveshaft with its two CV joints, 5-8 kg (recalled); one per driven wheel.

diff_axle_open.label: Axle differential (open)
diff_axle_open.source: [AS] crown wheel, pinion, carrier and the share of its housing and oil, 15-25 kg for a passenger-car final drive (recalled).

diff_axle_clutch_lsd.label: Axle differential (clutch LSD)
diff_axle_clutch_lsd.source: [AS] the open unit plus clutch packs and ramps, about 4 kg more (recalled).

diff_axle_torsen.label: Axle differential (Torsen)
diff_axle_torsen.source: [AS] the open unit with worm-gear internals instead of bevel gears, about 3 kg more (recalled).

diff_axle_viscous.label: Axle differential (viscous)
diff_axle_viscous.source: [AS] the open unit plus a viscous coupling, about 3 kg more (recalled).

diff_axle_locked.label: Axle differential (spool)
diff_axle_locked.source: [AS] a spool has no differential gears: about 2 kg less than the open unit.

diff_centre_open.label: Transfer case (open centre)
diff_centre_open.source: [AS] a transfer case with an open centre differential and its output to the second axle, 18-28 kg (recalled).

diff_centre_viscous.label: Transfer case (viscous centre)
diff_centre_viscous.source: [AS] the open transfer case plus a viscous coupling, about 3 kg more.

diff_centre_locked.label: Transfer case (locked)
diff_centre_locked.source: [AS] a part-time transfer case without a centre differential, about 2 kg less than the open one.

diff_centre_clutch_lsd.label: Transfer case (clutch centre)
diff_centre_clutch_lsd.source: [AS] as the viscous centre (physics_sim refuses this kind as a centre today; listed so a future kind has a figure).

diff_centre_torsen.label: Transfer case (Torsen centre)
diff_centre_torsen.source: [AS] as the viscous centre (physics_sim refuses this kind as a centre today; listed so a future kind has a figure).

layout_conversion.label: Layout conversion
layout_conversion.source: [AS] owner on PR #19 (2026-10-15): a drivetrain layout other than the car's stock one carries a weight penalty, because the drive has to run across the car like in an AWD setup. This is the hardware a body that was not built for the new layout needs on top of the new axle's own differential and half shafts (which the tree counts as for any car): gearbox output adapter / transfer gear, a transmission-tunnel crossmember and centre-bearing mount, the extra diff carrier mounts and subframe bracing, 10-20 kg (estimated, not cited). Added once per conversion, any direction.

conversion_driveline.label: Driveline along the car
conversion_driveline.source: [AS] the shaft that carries the drive the length of the car where the converted layout would otherwise have no more propshafts than the stock one (RWD to FWD, AWD to FWD/RWD, a front-engine RWD car made AWD gets its second shaft to the front axle this way): a full-length two-piece propshaft with an extra centre bearing, a little heavier than the 12 kg stock propshaft (estimated).

conversion_transfer.label: Transfer drive
conversion_transfer.source: [AS] a FWD/RWD swap (or an AWD car made 2WD) has no transfer case of its own, yet the drive must be taken from the gearbox to the far end of the car: a drop gear / transfer gearbox with its housing and oil, a little lighter than the 22 kg open-centre transfer case of an AWD conversion (estimated). With it a FWD to RWD swap costs about what an AWD conversion costs minus the axle that is no longer driven, as the owner asked.

steering.label: Steering
steering.source: [AS] rack (with assist), column and steering wheel, 12-17 kg (recalled).

brake_front.label: Front brake
brake_front.source: [AS] one front disc, caliper, pads and carrier, 10-15 kg for a ventilated passenger-car disc (recalled); only wheels the vehicle file's brake corners list get one.

brake_rear.label: Rear brake
brake_rear.source: [AS] one rear disc, caliper, pads and carrier, 6-10 kg (recalled).

suspension_front.label: Front suspension
suspension_front.source: [AS] per front corner: hub and bearing, knuckle, arms, spring, damper and half the anti-roll bar, 15-20 kg (recalled).

suspension_rear.label: Rear suspension
suspension_rear.source: [AS] per rear corner, as the front without the steering knuckle, 13-18 kg (recalled).

wheel_default.label: Wheel and tyre
wheel_default.source: physics_sim's WheelDesc::wheel_mass default (vehicle_desc.h), used when a wheel names no wheel_mass.

cooling_system.label: Cooling system
cooling_system.source: [AS] radiator, fan, hoses and coolant, 12-18 kg for a passenger car (recalled); present when the vehicle file names a cooling_system.

park_lock.label: Park lock
park_lock.source: [AS] the park pawl, its actuator and linkage in the gearbox, about 1 kg.

fuel_tank.label: Fuel tank (empty)
fuel_tank.source: [AS] a plastic tank with its pump and sender: 4 kg plus 0.12 kg per kg of capacity (a 45 kg / 60 l tank weighs about 9-10 kg empty, recalled).

nitrous_kit.label: Nitrous kit
nitrous_kit.source: [AS] plate or nozzle, solenoids, lines, switches and the bottle bracket, 3-5 kg (recalled).

n2o_bottle.label: Nitrous bottle (empty)
n2o_bottle.source: [AS] an aluminium bottle with its valve: about its own capacity in mass plus 1.5 kg (a 10 lb / 4.5 kg bottle weighs about 6 kg empty, recalled).

electronics_assist_unit.label: Assist unit
electronics_assist_unit.source: [AS] the ABS/ESC hydraulic unit with its controller and wheel-speed sensors, 2.5-4 kg (recalled).

electronics_drive_modes.label: Drive mode controller
electronics_drive_modes.source: [AS] a controller and switch, a few hundred grams.

electronics_epb.label: Electronic parking brake
electronics_epb.source: [AS] two caliper actuators and the controller, 2.5-3.5 kg (recalled).

electronics_launch_control.label: Launch control
electronics_launch_control.source: [AS] a controller and switch, a few hundred grams.

electronics_assist_fitment.label: Assist module
electronics_assist_fitment.source: [AS] a small controller module and its wiring.

electronics_other.label: Electronics part
electronics_other.source: [AS] any other electronics part a vehicle file names: a controller and its wiring.

engine_unknown.label: Engine
engine_unknown.source: [AS] fallback for an engine that is in neither the engine catalogue nor carries its own mass_kg: a mid-size passenger-car engine.

gearbox_unknown.label: Gearbox
gearbox_unknown.source: [AS] fallback for a gearbox that is not in the gearbox catalogue: a mid-size 6-speed manual (as touring_6mt).

fuel.label: Fuel
fuel.source: [D] The fuel in the tank at spawn: 1 kg per kg (the tank's initial_kg, physics_sim's default fill is the capacity).

n2o.label: Nitrous oxide
n2o.source: [D] The N2O in the bottle at spawn: 1 kg per kg (the component's or bottle file's initial_kg, else a full bottle).

turbo_unit.label: Turbocharger
turbo_unit.source: [AS] one turbocharger (compressor and turbine wheels, housings, bearing cartridge): 2 kg of fittings plus 7.5 kg x s^3, s = (rotor inertia / 2.3e-4 kg m2)^(1/5) the wheel size relative to a GTX3582R-class unit (about 9.5 kg, recalled), mass scaling with the cube of size; the same rule as the turbo kits (PR #21).

turbo_hot_side.label: Exhaust manifold and downpipe
turbo_hot_side.source: [AS] per turbocharger: the extra turbo manifold, wastegate and downpipe over the NA exhaust, about 3 kg per unit (recalled); size = the turbo count.

intercooler.label: Intercooler
intercooler.source: [AS] an air-to-air intercooler core and end tanks: 22.23 kg per kg/s of the turbos' summed maximum mass flow (a 0.6 kg/s core weighs about 13 kg, estimated); size = summed flow in kg/s.

charge_piping.label: Charge piping
charge_piping.source: [AS] aluminium charge pipes, 63 mm, 2 mm wall, about 3 m for one turbo (1.92 kg) plus 1 m (0.64 kg) per further unit (computed from 2700 kg/m3); size = turbo count - 1.

seat_comfort.label: Comfort seat
seat_comfort.source: [AS] a powered, heated front seat with its rails and motors, 20-25 kg (recalled).

seat_manual.label: Front seat
seat_manual.source: [AS] a manually adjusted front seat with rails, 13-17 kg (recalled).

seat_vintage.label: Bench seat half
seat_vintage.source: [AS] a sprung, horsehair-padded vintage seat on a wooden frame, 8-10 kg per place (estimated).

seat_sport_bucket.label: Sport bucket seat
seat_sport_bucket.source: [AS] a fixed-back glass-fibre bucket seat with its side mounts, 10-13 kg (recalled).

seat_carbon_bucket.label: Carbon bucket seat
seat_carbon_bucket.source: [AS] a carbon-fibre racing shell with thin padding and mounts, 5-8 kg (recalled).

rear_bench.label: Rear seats
rear_bench.source: [AS] a split-folding rear bench (cushion, backrests, headrests, belt hardware), 20-28 kg (recalled).

rear_bench_small.label: Rear seats (small)
rear_bench_small.source: [AS] the rear bench of a small car or 2+2 coupe, 12-16 kg (estimated).

rear_bench_vintage.label: Rear bench
rear_bench_vintage.source: [AS] a sprung vintage rear bench on a wooden frame, 14-18 kg (estimated).

audio_system.label: Audio system
audio_system.source: [AS] head unit, amplifier, six to ten speakers and their wiring, 7-11 kg (recalled).

audio_basic.label: Audio (basic)
audio_basic.source: [AS] a head unit and two to four light speakers with wiring, 3-4 kg (estimated).

door_trim_4door.label: Door trim (four doors)
door_trim_4door.source: [AS] four door cards with armrests, window-switch packs and insulation, 3-4 kg each (recalled).

door_trim_2door.label: Door trim (two doors)
door_trim_2door.source: [AS] two long coupe door cards with armrests and insulation, 4-5 kg each (estimated).

door_trim_hyper.label: Door trim (carbon)
door_trim_hyper.source: [AS] two thin carbon/Alcantara door panels, about 1 kg each (estimated).

dash_full.label: Dashboard
dash_full.source: [AS] dashboard carrier, instrument cluster, centre console, glovebox and trim panels (the HVAC unit and the airbags' modules are in the body), 25-32 kg (recalled).

dash_compact.label: Dashboard (compact)
dash_compact.source: [AS] the simpler dashboard and console of a small car, 18-22 kg (estimated).

dash_classic.label: Dashboard (classic)
dash_classic.source: [AS] a padded steel dash with chrome gauges and a wood or vinyl fascia, 15-20 kg (estimated).

dash_hyper.label: Dashboard (carbon)

dash_vintage.label: Dashboard (vintage)
dash_vintage.source: [AS] a wooden dash board with a few gauges and switches, 3-5 kg (estimated).

sound_deadening_sedan.label: Sound deadening
sound_deadening_sedan.source: [AS] bitumen pads, foam and felt under the carpets, in the doors and the bulkhead of a saloon, 15-22 kg (recalled).

sound_deadening_small.label: Sound deadening (small car)
sound_deadening_small.source: [AS] the same for a small car, 8-12 kg (estimated).

sound_deadening_classic.label: Sound deadening (classic)
sound_deadening_classic.source: [AS] tar-board pads and jute of an older car, 12-16 kg (estimated).

sound_deadening_hyper.label: Sound deadening (minimal)
sound_deadening_hyper.source: [AS] the little insulation a carbon hypercar has around the cabin, 2-4 kg (estimated).

carpets.label: Carpets
carpets.source: [AS] moulded carpets with their underlay and the boot liner, 10-14 kg (recalled).

carpets_small.label: Carpets (small)
carpets_small.source: [AS] the same for a small car or an open tourer, 6-9 kg (estimated).

carpets_hyper.label: Carpets (light)

spare_wheel_full.label: Full-size spare and jack
spare_wheel_full.source: [AS] a full-size steel spare wheel and tyre, jack and brace, 22-27 kg (recalled).

hood_steel_vintage.source: [AS] the thin hinged steel bonnet of a vintage car, 6-8 kg (estimated).
